label: Order
caption: AL CANNON, SHERIFF V. BRODERICK WILLIAM SEAY, JR.
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit, case No. 18-7242, is hereby stayed pending receipt of a response, due on or before Friday, August 16, 2019, by 3 p.m. ET, and further order of the undersigned or of the Court.
